paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
notes: This paper identifies an ALLOWED parameter region (not an exclusion limit) in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane that solves the TeV gamma-ray transparency tension with CIBER CIB data. Region: m_a ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV, g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. The data points given are corner bounds of the allowed contour, not a continuous exclusion curve. The detailed contour shape is in Fig. 5 (not numerically tabulated).
